decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - (1) The trellis shall be retained as modified on site (24/9/01) and shall not be increased in height unless first agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

(2) The trellis shall be landscaped in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by by the Local Planning Authority within 3 months of the date of this planning decision.  The details shall include planting beds specifications, schedules of plants include species, plant sizes, and numbers/densities.  The landscaping shall be planted in the planting season immediately following aproval of the details and thereafter permanently maintained.

(3) No development shall take place until a schedule of landscape maintaenance for a minimum period of 5 years has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The schedule shall include details of the arrangements for its implementations.  Development shall be carried out in accurance with these details.

(1) In the interests of the visual amenities of the area (applicable to conditions (1) (2) and (3).
description: Erection of Trellis fencing to existing boundary wall
